sn56.13:1.3: dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.13:3.2: yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatra tatrābhinandinī, seyyathidaṃ:
sn56.13:4.2: yo tassāyeva taṇhāya asesa virāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.
sn56.13:5.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sn56.13:5.4: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.13:6.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
